title: First Morning: Market Coffee and Cobblestones
label: Daily Life · Trastevere
description: I woke up to the sound of the street below coming to life — carts, voices, and the soft clink of espresso cups. I walked to the corner bar where no one spoke English, ordered my first cappuccino entirely in broken Italian, and watched the city stretch awake.

title: Getting Lost on Purpose After Class
label: Daily Life · Centro Storico
description: Instead of taking the tram home, I decided to walk with no map — just following whatever alley looked most interesting. I kept stumbling onto tiny churches, laundry hanging overhead, and little pockets of quiet that made the city feel strangely intimate.

title: When a Routine Finally Started to Form
label: Daily Life · Testaccio
description: Somewhere between the morning walk across the Tiber, afternoon classes, and evening grocery runs, life here stopped feeling like a trip and more like a life I belonged to, even if only temporarily.
